in_hebrew.name: ולד
in_hebrew.long_meaning: ולד (Vlad) - ' ruler' / 'lord' / 'master' - originates from the Hebrew word 'adal' (meaning 'ruler', 'judge', or 'master') - in biblical context, the name Vlad is associated with the concept of divine rulership and authority - a name that signifies leadership, strength, and wisdom in the Christian tradition

in_greek.name: Βλάδιος
in_greek.long_meaning: Βλάδιος (Vládios) - 'lord' / 'ruler' - derived from the Greek word 'kurios' (meaning 'lord', 'master', or 'ruler') - in the New Testament, the name Vlad is associated with the concept of divine authority and leadership - a name that signifies wisdom, strength, and nobility in the Christian tradition - in early Christian church, the name Vlad was used to signify a person of high social status or authority

in_latin.name: Vlad
in_latin.meaning: meaning 'ruler' or 'lord' with strong connotations of authority and leadership
in_latin.long_meaning: Vlad - derived from the Latin word 'vulgus' (meaning 'multitude' or 'common people') - in the early Christian church, the name Vlad was used to signify a leader or a person of authority among the Christian community - a name that conveys strength, wisdom, and nobility in the Christian tradition - historically, the name Vlad was associated with the concept of divine rulership and authority, signifying a person's connection to the divine
